attempts.problem: Monolithic controller coupled session, science workflows, persistence and GUI.
attempts.change: Split into eight design responsibilities and pass frozen artifacts downstream.
attempts.result: Dense coupling reduced to ordered dependencies.

attempts.problem: GUI touched ZOS-API directly and analysis generated its own experiment matrix.
attempts.change: Use a thin CustomTkinter workflow shell and an independent deterministic manifest builder.

attempts.problem: Persistence was placed late in the matrix, hiding the fact that Assets, B0, Carrier, Manifest and Analysis all write formal artifacts and run state.
attempts.change: Recast DP-007 as Project Store & Run State Boundary, place it immediately after Session in execution order, and expose all one-way dependencies in the matrix.
attempts.result: Dependencies are explicit and the design remains lower-triangular/decoupled without adding modules.
